tei:div.tei:p: "!# ༁ྃ: tshe sgrub gnam lcags rdo rje dngos grub kun 'dus las: bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad dngos grub snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so: :

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ e ma ho: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: mdo rgyud man ngag thams cad kyi snying po bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad ces bya ba: 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du: ston pa kun tu bzang pos gsungs shing: rig gdangs kyi 'khor rnams la dgongs brgyud mdzad: lha gnas gsum du grags pa'i zhing du rig 'dzin brda brgyud kyis yi ge'i tshul bstan: 'phags yul mchod rten bde byed brtsegs par mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo che la gnyer gtad mdzad: ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas mnga' gsol zhing: rig 'dzin chen po brgyad kyis ston pa'i tshul bzung: rang byung lhun grub padma 'byung gnas kyis grub pa thob nas: bod yul mun pa'i gling du chos kyi sgron me sbar bar dgongs nas: lha srin dregs pa thams cad dam la btags: bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang bkod: rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan la sogs skal ldan gyi skyes bu rnams smin grol byang chub kyi lam la bkod: dus ma 'ongs pa'i sems can dug lnga'i dbang du 'gro ba la dgongs nas zab gter gyis ri lung thams cad bkang: bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi chos tshan brgya dang sum cu rtsa lnga rnams gang la gang 'dul du sil bur bkrams te: sgrub thabs che 'bring chung gsum thams cad kha tshang don 'dril ba: tha na'ang tshig sho lo ka re re la yang zab gnad khyad du thon pa re re byas nas gter kha shin tu mang bar sbas: ma 'ongs pa na sems can gyi don rgya chen po yong bar lung bstan dang bcas te gsungs pa rnams: bdag mkhar chen bzas mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob pas yi ger bkod: khyad par du tshe sgrub zab mo gnam lcags rdo rje dngos grub kun 'dus kyi cha lag tu: bi ma la'i chos spyod rab gsal dang: bka' brgyad dngos grub snying po zhes bya ba nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang po'i thugs dam yang dag pa'o:

bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi chos skor rnams ni gzhan las kyang khyad par du 'phags pa'o: ci'i phyir na: slob dpon chen po padma'i thugs dam gyi lha rtsod med du grags pa yin cing: ma 'ongs pa na'ang rjes 'jug thams cad 'di las grub pa thob pa mang bar gsungs: des na the tshom yid gnyis ma byed par: sgrubs shig: shod cig: ston cig: sgoms shig: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rgyal ba khro bo'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi bsnyen sgrub kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la: dang po lta bas mtshams bcad pa: gnyis pa 'byung ba rim brtsegs nas gzhal yas khang bskyed pa: gsum pa lha tshogs gsal gdab pa: bzhi pa spyan 'dren byin 'beb pa: lnga pa bdag nyid mchod bstod dbul ba: drug pa phyi nang dbyer med bsre ba: bdun pa drag sngags ting 'dzin bzlas pa: brgyad pa bskul zhing phrin las bcol ba'o: de la dang po lta bas mtshams gcod pa ni: hūm̐: ye nas khro rol rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: snod bcud snang grags gsal stong ye shes ngang: ru tra dgra bgegs gnyis 'dzin ka nas dag: lha dang 'dre gnyis ma grub rang gi sems: hūm̐: 'di ltar ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i rang gzugs las: sdug bsngal grong khyer 'khor ba'i sems can byung: kun kyang ma bcos lhug pa'i sems nyid 'di: skad cig dran rdzogs sgyu lus he ru ka'i: thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer dpag med ni: phyag mtshan yig 'bru sku gzugs me 'od 'phros: bar chad 'byung po brlag cing srung 'khor gyur: phyi dang nang med rol pa chen po'i klong: oṃ hūm̐ āḥdzaḥphaṭa: oṃ badzra kro dha sarba sa ma ya: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: hūm̐: ye nas thams cad zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: phyag 'tshal kun rdzob don dam brda dang gar: phyi nang gsang ba gnyis med don gyis mchod: srog gi phyir yang mi spang bsgrub par bya'o: badzra sa ma ya: a ti pū ho:

pra tītstsha ho: ya mi na mo: hūm̐: kun nas thams cad rang sems zhi khro'i lha: bshags dang bshags bya mi dmigs btang snyoms ngang: nyams chag nyes ltung dri ma klong du grol: kun kyang dbyer med khyab brdal dkyil 'khor che: swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ swā hā: hūm̐: kun khyab kun byed dbyings rig klong yangs las: 'gag med gsal dag rang rig yi ge hūm̐: de las e yaṃ ra suṃ keṃ raṃ bhrūm̐: rim bzhin nam mkha' rlung khrag sa gzhi dang: rus pa'i ri rab me 'od bhandha'i mkhar: ma bcos lhun grub 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gsal: phyogs mtshams ris med stong gsal mtha' dbus bral: a 'thas ma yin sgyu lus pho brang che: bhrūm̐ bi shwa bi shuddhe bhrūm̐: hūm̐: rang rig yi ge hūm̐ gi 'phro 'du las: 'od zer dpag yas mchod 'bul 'gro don grub: ma bcos rang shar dpal chen he ru ka: sku mdog smug nag gzi brjid 'od zer 'bar: nyi shu rtsa gcig zhal rnams khro zhing rngam: ljags 'dril rno ngar mche ba dkar la gtsigs: ya so khro bo ma so khro mo'i gzugs: kha rlangs thams cad dug dud sprin ltar 'thul: nyi zla lta bu'i spyan rnams sdang mig bgrad: smin ma glog ltar 'od 'khyugs gza' skar sbreng: dbu skra dmar ser gyen 'khyil me stag 'phro: shangs nas bskal pa'i rlung 'tshubs sprul pa 'gyed: sma ra me lce 'bar bas hūm̐ sgra sgrog: zhal nas chu tshan khol ma'i rba klong 'khrug: snyan nas stong gsum 'ching ba'i dud sprin 'thibs: yum chen kun tu bzang mo sku la 'khril: hūm̐: phyag gi dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis la: rgyal ba bzhi bcu yab rnams g.yas na bzhugs: yum rnams g.yon bzhugs thub drug g.yas g.yon bzhengs: zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum byol song gtso brgyad steng: 'gying bag stobs ldan me dpung klong du gsal: de yi thugs kar dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad: sku mdog smug nag zhabs brgyad dregs pa brdzis:

phyag g.yas rdo rje kha ṭāṃ rnge'u chung dang: 'khor lo rin chen padma ral gri dang: dgra st+wa zhags pa dgu ni g.yas su thogs: phyag g.yon bhan dmar zhing dbyug thong gshol dang: nyi zla ri rab khrag mtsho me rlung dgu: rab 'jigs khro tshul yum dang gnyis med 'khril: de yi thugs kar dbu gsum phyag drug pa: mthing dkar dmar zhal phyag g.yas rdo rje gsum: g.yon gsum bhandha rnam gsum zhabs bzhi bgrad: yum mchog gnam zhal dbyings phyug gnyis med 'khril: de yi thugs kar don gyi he ru ka: smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis dor stabs bgrad: rdo rje bhan dmar 'dzin cing khro tshul tsam: ting 'dzin ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: mdun du mthing nag gru gsum dky-il 'khor du: thugs kyi lha mchog badzra he ru ka: zhal gsum phyag drug mthing nag dkar dmar zhal: rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ rnge'u chung g.yas na bsnams: bhan dmar dril bu rgyu zhags yum dang 'khril: hūm̐: g.yas su ser nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor du: 'jam dpal gshin rje ser nag dkar dmar zhal: phyag drug be con ral gri dgra st+wa g.yas: bhan dmar sdigs mdzub mdung thung g.yon na bsnams: yum mchog be ta za byed sku la 'khril: hūm̐: rgyab tu dmar nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor du: padma gsung mchog rta mgrin dmar smug ni: dmar dkar sngo ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug pa: rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ sbrul zhags g.yas su bsnams: dril bu bhan dmar lcags sgrog yum dang 'khril: hūm̐: g.yon du ljang nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor du: phrin las rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum ni: ljang nag dkar dmar zhal gsum phyag drug pa: rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga kha ṭwāṃ me: phyag gi mtha' gnyis phur pa thugs kar 'dril: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum dang gnyis med 'khril: hūm̐: shar lho bla med he ru yab yum ni: mthing nag dkar dmar zhal gsum phyag drug pa: rdo rje khyung chen sbrul zhags g.yas na bsnams:

phyag g.yon bhandha zhing dbyug ga 'u 'dzin: nyid bzhi mu kha le dang gnyis med 'khril: hūm̐: lho nub rig 'dzin slob dpon rdor dril bsnams: rdo rje phag mo yum dang gnyis med 'khril: rin chen rus pa'i rgyan cha khro lau lau: lhab lhub dar gyi na bza' sku la gsol: 'khor du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rgya mtshos bskor: hūm̐: nub byang dregs 'dul kham nag smug mthing zhal: rdo rje lha brgyad mgo bo g.yas su thogs: bhan dmar klu brgyad mgo bo g.yon du thogs: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'gying bag gzi brjid can: khams gsum spyi 'dul yum dang gnyis med 'khril: hūm̐: byang shar stobs ldan zhal gsum mthing nag la: phyag drug rdo rje lha brgyad tsitta g.yas: bhan dmar klu brgyad tsitta g.yon du bsnams: zhabs gnyis dor stabs khro tshul 'gying bag ldan: 'byung lnga'i bdag mo yum dang gnyis med 'khril: hūm̐: de ltar tshom bu dgu yi lha tshogs rnams: yab yum sras dang sprul pa 'khor dang bcas: bka' brgyad lha tshogs bdun brgya nyi shu rnams: phyogs mtshams med par 'od zer mtha' yas khengs: rang rang gnas gsum 'od kyis spyan drangs bstim: hūm̐: chos dbyings mnyam nyid rig pa'i ye shes lha: bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha tshogs rnams: ma bcos lhun grub dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.ā: sa ma ya ā be sha ya tiṣṭha lhan: rang rig ye shes lha la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: rang byung thabs shes dbyer med sman gyis mchod: rgyu rkyen rnam dag bdud rtsi gtor mas mchod: chags bral rakta dmar chen rdzas kyis mchod: phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin nyid kyis mchod: gnyis med blang dor med pa'i ngang du mchod: sarba pañtsa a mṛta la khā hi: ma hā rakta la khā hi: ma hā ba liṃ ta la khā hi: ma hā māṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā tsitta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: hūm̐: 'jam dpal sku yi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod:

padma gsung gi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: yang dag thugs kyi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: che mchog yon tan lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: phur pa phrin las lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: ma mo rbod gtong lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: rig 'dzin slob dpon lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: dmod pa drag sngags lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'od zer 'phro: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon tshul zhi ba'i sku: mtshan dang dpe byad rgyan rnams mdzes tshul ldan: zhi ba'i tshul dgu rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung ba dang: rgod dang gshe dang rngam par ston pa dang: snying brtses khro dang ngo mtshar gar dgu ldan: khro bo'i gar dgu rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: thal chen rakta zhag gi zo ris dang: ko rlon g.yang gzhi stag gi sham thabs dang: thod phreng sbrul chun me dpung chas dgus brgyan: dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: bcom ldan dpal chen kun bzang rigs lnga yab: bzang mo la sogs kro dhī yum rnams sbyor: sems dpa' lcam sras thub drug sgo ba dang: zhi khro yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: kun bzang thugs kyi 'od zer cho 'phrul las: lha tshogs bdun brgya nyi shu'i dkyil 'khor shar: mtha' yas dpag med ye shes me 'od 'bar: bar chad sdig sgrib bsregs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: yang dag thugs kyi dkyil 'khor rol pa las: thams cad mnyam nyid byang chub sems kyi ngang: spros pas mtha' 'das bsdus pas rang bzhin klong: lhun grub zhi khro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas snying po bzlas pa ni: 1$0000250gtso 'khor thams cad kyi thugs ka'i 'od zer 'phro 'du la dmigs 1$0000300 te bzla'o: che mchog gi snying po ni: oṃ badzra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: yang dag thugs kyi snying po ni:

oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭa: 'jam dpal sku'i snying po ni: oṃ a kro te ka ya mānta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭa: padma gsung gi snying po ni: oṃ padmānta kṛta ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: phur pa phrin las la: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnāks+yan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: ma mo rbod gtong gi snying po ni: oṃ gu hya dzñā na shrī he ru ka kro dhī shwa rī st+waṃ ma yo gi nī hūm̐ phaṭa: rig 'dzin snying po ni: oṃ badzra gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐ phaṭa: 'jig rten mchod bstod kyi snying po ni: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba duṣṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: dmod pa drag sngags la: oṃ badzra sarba duṣṭāṃ e dzaḥbhyo hūm̐ phaṭa: dpal gyi bka' sdod la: oṃ badzra sarba yaksha sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa: khyung spyi gtsug tu bzhugs pa la: khroṃ ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa: spyi 'dus drag sngags me dpung ni/ oṃ badzra ma hā kro dha padma kro dhī shwa rī badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yaksha kā la rū pa karmā raṃ raṃ dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: dmod bcol ni: gnod byed gdon bgegs 'byung po'i snying la duṣṭāṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: bzla bar bya'o: gang zag dbang po rab 'bring tha dang bstun te: che mchog sku gang mos su bsgom yang rung: snying po yang de dang mtshungs: tshogs dang skong ba tshar ba dang: de nas thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: ma g.yel sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha tshogs rnams: mi mngon dbyings nas ye shes spyan gyis gzigs: bka' sdod dam can srung mas bya ra mdzod: kun mkhyen mgon pos gzu dang dpang mdzod cig: hūm̐: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i sems can rnams: thar pa bsgrub kyang bar chad dbang btsan na: thugs rje'i myur mgyogs byin rlabs dus la bab: 'phral rkyen ngan pa'i bar chad thams cad zlog: dus min 'chi ba'i dbang du mi gtang bar: tshe srog dbang thang nyams pa gso ru gsol: sgrub mchog bdag la dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol:

khyad par drag po mthu yi dngos grub zhu: hūm̐: ma rig gti mug rmongs pas 'khor bar 'khyams: rgyu rkyen las ngan dgra bgegs ngar 'dzin 'di: thog med dus nas gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa las: rig pa'i rgyal po khro chen lha tshogs bskul: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi spyi mes kun bzang yab: skye 'gro yongs kyi ma mo kun bzang yum: sras 'khor bka' sdod lha tshogs sku bzhengs shig: dkon mchog thugs rje rten 'brel bslu med mthus: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad ru tra ma lus kun: dmigs yul gzugs phung liṅga 'di nyid la: skad cig nyid la khug cig sa ma ya: 'khor 'das lha dang phrol cig khro bo'i tshogs: hūm̐: drag po'i thun gyis brabs pas myos par 'gyur: gtsang ma'i khrus kyis dug lnga'i bag chags zhi: thugs ka'i 'od kyis tshe rten rang la bstim: phaṭa kyi rang sgras rnam shes dbyings rig bsre: hūm̐: snang srid khro rol dgra bgegs dum bur gtub:lcags kyu phur pas gar nyams glog ltar 'khyug: lnga phung gzugs kyis rab 'byams dkyil 'khor mchod: bdag 'dzin rtsad nas chod cig mā ra ya: hūm̐: rgyal ba rgya mtsho bdud rtsi mchod pas mnyes: yi dam khro rol sha khrag dmar gyis tshim:mkha' 'gro chos skyong nang rol zhag gis dgyes: kun nas kun tu longs spyod thogs med shog: hūm̐: ka dag chos nyid yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: rang byung rang shar khro bo rol pa'i tshogs:bskyed rdzogs ma bcos lhun grub ye nas dag: ngar 'dzin ru tra gnyis med klong du ho:

che mchog khro bo rol pa'i nyams len snying por dril ba'i man ngag gnad kyi gzer thems gcig pu: bdag mdun tha mi dad kyi dkyil 'khor rgyun khyer dngos grub snying po zhes bya ba: bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bris pa sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes gu ru padma'i thugs kyi 'od zer las sprul pa sngags 'chang hūm̐ nag me 'bar gyis shar ljon pa lung gi gnas sgo nas gdan drangs pa'o////
